messages.subject: [Project X] Executive Kickoff: Goals, Scope & Q3 Objectives
messages.body:
Hi Team,

Welcome to the official kickoff for Project X! As discussed in the executive steering meeting, our primary goals for this initiative are:
1. Expand into new enterprise healthcare compliance markets.
2. Deliver zero-downtime, 99.99% availability data synchronization.
3. Establish full FHIR-compliant interoperability with legacy Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems.
4. Ensure SOC2 Type II and HIPAA data isolation by the end of this quarter.

The board has allocated an initial Q3 budget of $450,000. Sarah Chen will act as Executive Sponsor and Alex Rivera will lead technical execution. Let's make this launch a success!

Best,
Sarah Chen
VP of Product
messages.snippet: Project X core goals are expanding into new enterprise healthcare compliance markets, targeting 99.99% availability, establishing FHIR-compliant interoperability with legacy hospital EHR systems, and achieving HIPAA compliance with an approved $450,000 budget.

messages.subject: [Project X] Architecture Decisions: Event-Driven Sync & Zero-Trust Auth
messages.body:
Team,

Following yesterday's RFC review, here are the finalized architecture decisions for Project X:
- Ingestion Pipeline: We are adopting an event-driven sync pipeline utilizing Kafka streams to decouple real-time updates from core database writes.
- Authentication: Zero-trust architecture with OAuth2 / OIDC token exchange.
- Security: Envelope encryption using AWS KMS Customer-Managed Keys (CMK) with per-tenant isolation.

Please review the PRD on Notion for task assignments.

Regards,
David Kim
Principal Architect
messages.snippet: Architecture consensus reached: We will adopt an event-driven sync pipeline with Kafka streams, zero-trust OAuth2/OIDC token exchange, and AWS KMS envelope encryption with per-tenant data isolation.

messages.subject: URGENT: SOC2 Type II & HIPAA Compliance Deadlines
messages.body:
Sarah & Alex,

Our third-party audit firm (Coalfire) has scheduled our SOC2 Type II and HIPAA audit baseline starting November 15. All HIPAA data isolation controls and immutable audit logging must be deployed in staging by October 30. Any delay beyond this will defer our enterprise pilot rollout to Q1 next year.

Please ensure the compliance tasks on Notion and Jira have top engineering priority.

Best,
Rachel Hayes
Chief Compliance Officer
messages.snippet: SOC2 Type II & HIPAA audit begins Nov 15. All HIPAA data isolation controls and immutable audit logging must be deployed to staging by October 30 deadline.
